idea.title: Sorry for my own voice
idea.summary: A shaky first call where you apologise for your own voice, met by a fellow first-timer; confidence is a gym and the first rep is just saying hi.
hookOptions: I said sorry for my own voice
My voice shook on my first call
Nobody is good at call one

scenes.say: My first call, my voice shook so bad I apologised.
Confidence is a gym. Rep one: just say hi.

messages.text: sorry, my voice is so shaky lol
mine too, this is my first call
ok good, we can be shaky together

scenes.say: One call, one big laugh, one new favourite snack.
Your next rep is one tap away.

post.caption: Confidence isn't a switch, it's reps. One small hello at a time, with someone who has no idea who you are. What would your first rep be? Try one at randomtalker.com
post.youtubeTitle: I said sorry for my own voice #shorts
post.xText: Confidence is just reps. Start with one hello to a stranger. randomtalker.com
